notes.title: 🎮 Pentaquin Demo Now Available on Steam Deck! 🎮
notes.content:
We’re excited to share an update about Pentaquin: Deeds Of Twilight! While we’re still working hard on completing the full version of the game, we’re happy to announce that you can now play the demo on your Steam Deck. This is a fantastic opportunity for the community to experience the world of Pentaquin and help shape its development. 🎮

[h2]🔥 What You Can Expect on Steam Deck:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Optimized Demo Experience: The controls and visuals of the demo have been tested to ensure smooth gameplay on the Steam Deck.
[*] Steam Deck’s Unique Features Supported: The demo is fully compatible with the device’s native resolution (1280x800) and supports both touch and controller inputs.
[/list]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2477670/Pentaquin_Deeds_Of_Twilight_Demo]🕹️ Get your hands on Deck and try out the latest demo here! 🕹️[/url]

[h2]🎯 Our Plans for the Full Version[/h2]

We’re committed to bringing the full version of Pentaquin: Deeds Of Twilight to the Steam Deck. Here’s where we stand:
[list]
[*] Development Progress: Ongoing tests are showing promising results, and we’re focused on creating an optimized and polished experience for Steam Deck users.
[*] Steam Deck Certification: Achieving the “Steam Deck Verified” badge is a key part of our roadmap.
[/list]
[h2]🌟 Help Us Improve![/h2]

By playing the demo on your Steam Deck, you can provide valuable feedback. Let us know your thoughts, and together, we can make the game even better for its full release.

[h2]💬 Stay in the Loop:[/h2]

Follow our Community Hub and join [url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fdiscord.com%2Finvite%2F6BVG5WFpfW]our official Discord channel[/url] to keep up with the latest updates and announcements.

Thank you for your support! We’re looking forward to seeing you explore Pentaquin’s world, and we can’t wait to bring the full adventure to the Steam Deck soon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40367215/f9fcec8d0b5df5e4f6533d596984fd02fb7c4a40.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Pentaquin @ gamescom 2024
notes.content:
We’re thrilled to announce that Pentaquin: Deeds Of Twilight will be showcased at devcom, gamescom, and Courage Cologne this August! This is your chance to experience the latest demo of our 2D Platformer, dive into the world of Pentaquin, and meet the developers behind the game.

📅 Where to Find Us:

[list]
[*]  devcom (Indie Market): August 19th - 20th
[*]  gamescom (Creative Games Area, Hall 10.2): August 21th - 25th
[*]  Courage Cologne @ devcom Developer Night: August 20th
[/list] 

Don’t miss this opportunity to play the newest demo of Pentaquin: Deeds Of Twilight and connect with the team behind the game. We can’t wait to see you there!

notes.title: Exclusive Live Demo & Q&A: Experience ‘Pentaquin: Deeds Of Twilight’ Up Close!
notes.content:
Welcome to our exclusive livestream during the Steam Next Fest! Join us as we dive into the enchanting world of ‘Pentaquin: Deeds Of Twilight’. This event will feature an exclusive gameplay demo showcasing the latest demo version, including an improved demo level, our new story cinematic, the latest content additions, and improved gameplay mechanics. You'll get a chance to see the beautifully hand-drawn graphics and experience the deep, captivating storyline firsthand.

[u]What to expect:[/u]
[list]
[*] [b]Exclusive Gameplay Demo:[/b] Be among the first to see the latest demo version including new game features and levels.
[*] [b]Developer Q&A:[/b] Ask your burning questions directly to the team and get in-depth answers.
[*] [b]Community Interaction:[/b] Engage with other fans and players and share your thoughts on the game!
[/list]

Mark your calendar and join us for an unforgettable journey into the world of Pentaquin: Deeds Of Twilight! We look forward to seeing you there and hearing your questions.
